notes.title: WORKSHOP IS NOW LIVE
notes.content:
A long awaited feature is now available!

You are now able to submit your own CUSTOM GENDERS to STEAM WORKSHOP, as well as download other people's genders!




P.S. If your game happens to crash after this update, follow these instructions to fix:

1. Right click FEMINAZI in your Steam Library, select Properties
2. Go to Updates tab, and UNCHECK"Enable Steam Cloud Synchronization" at the bottom
3. Make a backup first and then delete your Feminazi data folder (or rename)  at: Users\User\APPDATA\Local\Feminazi
4. Go back to Updates tab in Properties and CHECK "Enable Steam Cloud Synchronization" at the bottom
5. If the game asks you to synch files, select the "UPLOAD" option with the newer files

The game should work now. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: The Future of FEMINAZI
notes.content:
The Future of FEMINAZI

It's been a month since we released FEMINAZI: The Triggering. So far it was well received by the audience but we feel the work is not done yet. We are now working on improving the game as we feel it's not finished yet. The main issue we want to focus on is the meme factor! We believe that all meme games should give players freedom to create, rather than being limited to memes that are already in the game.

What we are planning to do is to add Steam Workshop support. So far the game has some costumization options that are suitable for Steam Workshop support. We are going to add the option to upload and download custom genders. No game has done it before. It will be a milestone in history of gaming industry. Other stuff that might support Steam Workshop will be banners and maybe others cosmetics. We'll try to think of the best way to do it.

The other thing we would like to focus on in the future is to turn a game into a sandbox. So far, you can play in main world with some NPCs that you can spawn with a console box (F4) but we plan to work on more, and give more interaction freedom to it.

The third thing we are working on are more minigames that will be better than the current ones. We only have few minigames and it's a shame. We need more!

ːtriggeredːːfemalegenderːːlgbtː

notes.title: 46 Hours to go on the Kickstarter - Stretch goals added!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/520/621/e813067574689bddc4a4cd84d0edc818_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1487190748&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9e5ae73cd9a1c3a06c4995a7f267e243[/IMG]
Hey everyone, 

We launched a Kickstarter for FEMINAZI a while back, mainly just to boost exposure and reach some new fans. But we've just hit [B]635%[/B] funded and have 46 hours left. It's gone so much better than we had anticipated!
